red_flags.flag: Clinical background with no management training at all: no budget, no P&L, no formal reports, no project she has been accountable for
red_flags.how: Show it through a story where the applicant made a commercial or people decision and carried others with them.

red_flags.flag: Took the Executive Assessment and scored 155 rather than sitting the GMAT or GRE, which some readers will treat as avoiding the harder test
red_flags.how: Point to the quantitative and academic evidence elsewhere in the file in one plain paragraph; no apology and no excuse.

red_flags.flag: English is her third language; speaking band 6.5 and visible hesitation under pressure
red_flags.how: Answer it with a specific story from the file rather than a claim.

red_flags.flag: Non-feeder employer: a single private hospital that no admissions reader will recognise
red_flags.how: Answer it with a specific story from the file rather than a claim.

red_flags.flag: Almost no international exposure - eight years in Vietnam and a three-week attachment in Cambodia
red_flags.how: Answer it with a specific story from the file rather than a claim.

red_flags.flag: Narrow functional scope: eight years in one 22-bed unit of one hospital
red_flags.how: Answer it with a specific story from the file rather than a claim.

red_flags.flag: Her stated goal sector recruits very few MBAs in her region, so the post-MBA path is unproven
red_flags.how: Make the short-term goal specific (role, sector, place) and connect it to a story that shows the motive.

kit_properties: Every number in every draft matches the Fact Sheet or a story's own numbers.
No draft names a person whose story marks them as not to be named.
No sentence uses any of these words: passionate, journey, impactful, life-saving, I saved him, hero, angel in white, calling, inspiring, leverage.

The goals essay names the short-term goal specifically: A hospital operations or provider-strategy role at group level in Southeast Asia - someone who decides how a unit runs rather than running a shift inside one.
The leadership essay leads with "The eye clinic", or the Strategist says why another story is stronger.
